happening.subject: anchor/node-yard
happening.text: The runner comes into the shut toll yard and finds every way out of it closed.

happening.subject: item/keepers-key
happening.text: The runner takes the keeper's key from the chest at the end of the passage.

objectives.hint: Go through the doorway in the yard's side wall. The chest is at the end of the passage, beside the bolted door.
objectives.title: Take the keeper's key

happening.subject: anchor/hearth-fire
happening.text: The embers on the yard's hearth stone are raked away.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-cart-road
happening.text: The fireback at the back of the yard's fireplace swings away, and the cart road's mouth stands open behind it.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-keeper-hatch
happening.text: The keeper's hatch on the ledge falls open over the cart road.

obj/take-the-key.text: The key turns the cart road's lock. The embers go out on the yard's fireplace beside the stair, its fireback swings away, and the old road's mouth stands open behind it, as wide as the stair. Up on the keeper's walk, the hatch has fallen open too.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-court-arch
happening.text: The runner goes the long way round to raise the bars on the arch.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-court-arch
happening.text: The runner pulls the lever in the toll house, and the bars on the yard's arch go up.

objectives.hint: Walk the cart road to its end. The lever is on the toll house floor, by the wall.
objectives.title: Pull the lever in the toll house

happening.subject: anchor/node-court
happening.text: The runner walks through the open arch into the inner court.

objectives.hint: The barred arch is across the yard from the stair. Draw the bolt of the toll house door to go back by the short way.
objectives.title: Go through the arch into the court

happening.subject: anchor/node-court
happening.text: The toll yard is a way through again.

happening.subject: anchor/seam-court-arch
happening.text: The bars on the yard's arch go up into the stone.

on_unlock.text: The bolt slides back. The passage to the yard is one door away now.

effects.text: The toll yard has been shut since the floods. The arch to the court is barred, the toll house door is bolted from its own side, and the keeper's hatch is locked. The keeper left the key in the chest at the end of the passage.
The door is bolted from the toll house side.
